I couldn't set up the recurring 17:30 "Pod end of day" post. My tools don't include a scheduler for posting to Slack, so I haven't scheduled anything and can't promise an automatic post.

I've replied in #strategic-pod with a correction to my first reply, which overstated the limitation. If you ask me in the channel around 17:30, I can post that day's new #strategic-pod messages as the end-of-day note. For a standing daily reminder, a calendar event would work.
